topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain's been coming down like the world's biggest fire hydrant. I figure it’s one of those nights where the street signs are just shadows and the whole damn city’s trying to wash its hands of what happened. Some guy called, voice all high and breaky, saying his ride got snatched from his driveway. I can practically see the hollow look in his eyes through the phone, and I know that driveway too well. It's the one I shouldn’t have left. Now, I’m out here again, with the only company being the echo of my own steps on the wet pavement. I'll find his car, sure as hell I will. But I can’t shake the memory of that driveway. It’s like a bad penny, always turning up when you least expect it.
